notes.title: Steel Echoes Expansion Update In Planning
notes.content:
Hello!

I want to thank everyone who played the game and everyone who gave back feedback about the game.
Having said that I wanted to announce, that I began planning an expansion for Steel Echoes. Stay tuned for more info!

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Steel Echoes v1.32
notes.content:
Fixed:

*Integrated automatic crash reports
*Fixed some colliders and triggers
*Statues (the moving ones) - don't run in one place after losing path

notes.title: Steel Echoes v1.31
notes.content:
Fixed:

*Statues (the moving ones) - don't move around as much
*Texture clipping on sill between rooms
*Door knocking animation
*Removed item requirement sounds after the requirements were completed (on doors)
*Separated breaker panel into 3 sections for easier use
